1.consolidated_definition: pol. Cuerpo de poder e influencia de un país representado por sus líderes económicos, sociales y políticos, o por cualquier otro grupo, cuyo interés es mantener el estatus quo. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Basta recordar que por años se torpedeó en Wáshington su aspiración a ser nombrada jueza federal aquí por su asociación cercana con el establishment del Partido Popular
1.en_consolidated_definition: Body of power and influence of a country represented by its economic, social, and political leaders, or by any other group, whose interest is to maintain the status quo. Raw Anglicism, common usage. It suffices to recall that for years her aspiration to be named federal judge here was torpedoed in Washington due to her close association with the establishment of the Popular Party.
